आदेि अंजतम होगा. इस अजधसूचना के अंतगित िाजमल की गई भूजम की भू-योिनाएं और अन्य जववरण उक्त सिमप्र ाजधकारी के कायािलय में उपलब्ध हैं और इच्छुक व्य जक्त द्व ारा उनका जनरीिण ककया िा सकता है. अनुसूची आंध्र प्र देि राज्य के एनटीआर जिले में जविेष रेलवे पररयोिना, जवियवाडा-जसकंदराबद रेलवे लाइन पर जवियवाडा और रायनपाडु स्ट् टेिनों के बीच रेलवे कक.मी.578/25-27 पर समपार फाटक सं. 150 के बदले ऊपरी सड़क पुल का D.Con./BZA/ROB/150/20A] सुनील कुमार वमाि, मुख्य इंिीजनयर/जनमािण-IV MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS (South Central Railway) NOTIFICATION Secunderabad, the 19th April, 2026 S.O. 2177(E). — In exercise of the power conferred by sub-section(1) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred in as the said Act), the Central Government after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which was given in the schedule annexed hereto, is required for execution of the Special Railway Project, namely, Construction of ROB in lieu of LC No. 150situated at Railway Km. 578/25-27 between Vijayawada and Rayanapadu stations on BZA–SC Railway line in NTR District in the state of Andhra Pradesh, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land: Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this notification in the official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act: Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Revenue Divisional Officer, Eluru, Eluru District, in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent authority Revenue Divisional Officer, Vijayawada, NTR District shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (II) of section 20(D) of the said act shall be final. The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority. -- 3 of 4 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] SCHEDULE Brief description of the land to be acquired with or without structure for the Special Railway Project namely: Construction of ROB in lieu of LC No. 150situated at Railway Km. 578/25-27 between Vijayawada and Rayanapadu stations on BZA–SC Railway line in NTR District in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
